training_data.name: trauma_assessment_training.jsonl
training_data.quote: This generates realistic trauma assessment conversations and corresponding professional reports. The generated dataset can be found at `trauma_assessment_training.jsonl`

languages.quote: Languages: Multilingual support (Arabic dialects, Ukrainian, English)

description.text: This is a fine-tuned version of Gemma 3N specifically optimized for conducting trauma assessments with children from conflict zones. The model is designed to facilitate empathetic, culturally-sensitive conversations and generate professional psychological reports.

output_type.quote: The model is designed to facilitate empathetic, culturally-sensitive conversations and generate professional psychological reports.

use_claim.quote: The model is designed to facilitate empathetic, culturally-sensitive conversations and generate professional psychological reports.

warning.quote: This model should not replace professional mental health assessment

serving.notes: The card and the usage example set context length and max_seq_length to 2048. config.json text_config max_position_embeddings is 32768. generation_config.json sets do_sample true, top_k 64, and top_p 0.95, and does not set temperature or max_new_tokens. The architecture is Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration and includes vision_config and audio_config. The notebook sets finetune_vision_layers to false. tokenizer_config sets use_default_system_prompt to false, and the usage example has no system message. The notebook calls save_pretrained_merged and push_to_hub_merged for this repository id. The repository still contains adapter_model.safetensors and deprecated_adapter_config.json alongside the full shards. The notebook sets gradient_accumulation_steps to 4 and does not pass load_in_4bit; the saved adapter config names the 4-bit Unsloth base.

discrepancies: The dataset filename matches. Inventory methods is lora and the parent is google/gemma-3n-E2B-it, which matches the card YAML. The same card's prose says the base is unsloth/gemma-3n-E2B-it. The notebook loads unsloth/gemma-3n-E2B-it with SFTTrainer. deprecated_adapter_config.json names unsloth/gemma-3n-e2b-it-unsloth-bnb-4bit, so the saved adapter is LoRA on a 4-bit base.
